title: Plan
description: The plan the planner returns. It carries every input a later step needs that takes judgment. The planner returns the plan whole, so no field is cut and none carries complete or total. A field whose description starts with "Can carry external content." may hold text taken from external content. Such a field goes to an agent only under the External Content Boundary in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/security-policy.md. It reaches a shell command only as one argument that first passes the identifier gate there (Shell Identifier Discipline), or through an inputs file the script reads as data (Inert Inputs-File Navigator Pattern), and is never spliced into command text. A field whose description starts with "Can carry external content. Repository path." holds one path relative to the top of the repository. The plan check refuses the plan, before the branch step and any later agent call, when such a path is empty, starts with /, has an empty, ., .. or .git (any case) part, or holds a control character, as the files rule of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/molt/scripts/molt.sh does.

summary.description: Can carry external content. What the plan delivers.

digest.description: The plan in two short sentences written for the user. A question about accepting the plan shows them as written, in place of the summary.

problem.description: Can carry external content. Written for the user: one plain sentence saying what the plan addresses, the ask of the request or the root cause a review found.

change.description: Can carry external content. Written for the user: one plain sentence saying what the plan changes.

remediation_gate.description: Whether accepting a plan that remediates review findings goes to the user, per the remediation plan rule of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md (Promotion Gate). Each flag, and each flag of promotion_gate, is true only for a plan that remediates review findings, and only while no reply in this run has accepted that condition. Every flag is false for any other plan.

promotion_gate.description: The whole Promotion Gate of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md, read against accepting the remediation plan. Its keys, required list and types are those of the gate of a decision brief in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/references/decision-brief-schema.json.

irreversible.description: True when accepting the remediation plan is irreversible, clause 1 of the Promotion Gate in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md.

architectural.description: True when accepting the remediation plan has architectural blast radius, clause 2 of the Promotion Gate in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md.

safety.description: True when accepting the remediation plan is safety-relevant, clause 3 of the Promotion Gate in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/decision-autonomy.md, which names the categories by reference to the Destructive Fix Gate.

grows_surface.description: True when the remediation adds more surface than it removes, per ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/remediation-doctrine.md (Surface-Growth Escalation).

repeats_surface.description: True when the remediation follows a fix on the same surface that did not close its class, per ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/remediation-doctrine.md (Forced zoom-out after the first non-closing structural fix).

branch.description: Can carry external content. The working branch the run delivers on. A run that starts on a branch other than trunk names that branch.

base.description: Can carry external content. The branch the working branch is created from: trunk unless the work stacks on another branch. Never the working branch itself. The branch step passes it to create-working-branch.

trunk_freshness.description: Copied from repository.trunk_freshness in the facts file the plan was made from. The workflow checks it against the facts step and decides trunk freshness from the facts, not from this field.

classification.description: The work classification. The branch step passes it to create-working-branch, and each commit takes its type from it.

breaking.description: True when the change breaks compatibility. Each commit then carries the breaking marker.

versioning.description: The plan's answers to the two judgments in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/versioning.md (Bump Type Determination), and the files that hold the version. The bump step passes the two answers to bump-type unchanged.

bump_trigger.description: yes when the change satisfies any Bump Trigger bullet. Passed to bump-type as --bump-trigger.

no_bump_match.description: yes when the change matches one or more bullets of the list of changes that need no bump by default. Passed to bump-type as --no-bump-match.

artifact_files.description: Each repository path holding a version the bump step sets, as the project's versioning docs name it. Empty when the project names none. The bump commit takes exactly these paths.

items.description: Can carry external content. Repository path. One file that holds a version.

validation_commands.description: Each entry is one gate command line the project's CLAUDE.md names. The validate step runs each entry once, in order, and the list never holds two forms of the same suites, such as a fuller and a narrower run of them. Empty when the planner can name no command: the validate step then runs the Validation Procedure of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md, which runs the gate command CLAUDE.md names, once, so validation is never skipped.

items.description: Can carry external content. One gate command line, copied from the project's CLAUDE.md. The plan check refuses the plan, before the branch step, when an entry is blank or holds a control character or a line break.

delivery.description: How the plan delivers. Both values run as one branch and one pull request. Brood is not a value.

steps.description: The plan's steps. depends_on sets their order.

items.description: One step of the plan, done by one worker.

id.description: Can carry external content. The step id, unique in the plan. depends_on names steps by it.

owner.description: The worker agent that does the step.

files.description: Every repository path the step may create or edit. The wave's commit takes exactly these paths.

items.description: Can carry external content. Repository path. One file the step may create or edit.

outcome.description: Can carry external content. What is true when the step is done.

depends_on.description: The steps that must finish before this one starts. Empty means none.

items.description: Can carry external content. The id of a step in this plan.

external_effects.description: Each effect the step has outside the repo, such as a deploy, a publish, a migration or other write to shared data, or a write to an outside service over the network. Empty means the step declares no effect outside the repo.

summary.description: Can carry external content. What the effect does and where.

reversible.description: False when the effect cannot be undone. A plan that declares such an effect goes to the user before the first wave.
